Mahjong is a tile-based game that originated in China. It's played by two to four players, using a set of 144 tiles, with each tile bearing one of several symbols, including dots, circles, and bamboo. The objective of the game is to be the first player to eliminate all their tiles by matching them with tiles on the board.

To play the game, players take turns placing tiles on the board, matching them with tiles that have already been placed in a certain pattern or configuration. A player can only place a tile if it matches the symbol or the number on an already placed tile. If a player cannot place a tile, they must pass their turn.

The game is won by the first player who eliminates all their tiles or the last player to take their turn if no player has eliminated all their tiles.
